integrity: All infinite-population conclusions follow analytically; exact small-population enumeration is a reproducibility check and not a substitute for proof. Source publication chronology is based on original arXiv version dates.
scientific_limitations: Results are for a focal-first uniform distinct-panel complete-graph process, fixed committee size and fixed number of initial plus agents, with 0<p<=1. The originating paper uses a different displayed finite-size media-term normalization; the proved theorem is not asserted for that alternate finite chain. Originality is based on located works and may be incomplete; no independent validation has occurred.
title: Exact rare-seed fixation and Moran comparison for the media-driven q-voter process
